title: Selected popup text has low contrast with bright accent colors
scope: Backlog only. Corrective color/binding changes remain deferred. Separate readable accent ink from the accepted vivid fill/swatch where needed.
environment: Qt 6.12.0 MSVC 2022 x64, production ColorComboBox in native Windows D3D11 WARP review frames. Physical Android popup contrast not independently measured.
evidence: The selected Accent-popup Green label is #00e676 on rendered #e1e1e1 in Light: 1.28:1. DeepOrange/Purple gives 3.09:1; Brown/Grey gives 2.05:1. The label is normal small text.
Dark default Green on the selected row is 7.95:1, but Purple is 3.41:1. A fix must consider both modes and the actual selected-row overlay.

Source shows selected ColorComboBox and Lists ComboBox delegate foregrounds use root.Material.accent directly. About selected-tab text and focus/slider cues use the same vivid accent family, but their complete rendered-state assessment remains a UX-003 follow-up.
Whole-scene native popup screenshots were used for final measurement to include the highlighted-row surface. Early subtree-only samples were discarded.
reproduction: Use Light theme with Green accent, open the Accent selector and inspect the selected Green caption on its highlighted row.
Run the popup cases in reviews/UX-001/tst_colorroles.qml; final data and representative frames are linked from reviews/UX-001.md.
Repeat with Purple and Grey accents, then Dark/System, using real production popup delegates.
expected: Selected-entry captions remain readable against their actual popup/highlight surfaces without sacrificing the selected vivid swatch/fill. Other controls preserve meaningful focus/state cues.
implementation_notes: Keep user-selected A400/A200 accent fills and picker swatches where practical. Consider a suitable same-family ink tone for text, or another contrasting selection cue, rather than dulling the entire palette.
Measure the actual selected-row background including overlays, not just the popup's base color.
Check Lists selected labels, About selected-tab ink and meaningful slider/focus indicators under UX-003; those additional rendered failures are candidates until measured.
Do not require decorative control borders to meet non-text targets when they are not the identifying cue. Meaningful focus/state cues still need sufficient contrast.
Retain current popup safe-area behavior and Android Back handling; UI-010/UI-016 are not reopened.
acceptance_criteria: Add a permanent automated regression on actual selected popup text and rendered row surfaces; confirm failure before and success after the correction.
Reach 4.5:1 for these small captions across representative palettes and Light/Dark/System, including live palette changes and highlighted/current states.
Preserve the chosen vivid swatches/fills and existing popup geometry/Back behavior.
Validate relevant Android popup rendering with isolated data; record any untested candidate controls separately rather than claiming whole-app contrast coverage.
